guidedSteps.title: Viet test chung minh crash-safety va hand-audit mot thang sinh day du
guidedSteps.goal: RecurringGenerationFailureTest buoc mot loi giua chung (sau create(), truoc khi nextDueDate tien) va assert nextDueDate KHONG doi; mot lan chay lap lai generate() nhieu lan cho mot thang sinh dung so luong giao dich voi sourceRef phan biet nhau; toan bo suite van pass.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Buoc nay kiem chung tinh nguyen tu ma R8/R20 doi hoi: neu ung dung crash dung giua create() va advanceNextDueDate(), ca hai phai cung roll back - khong bao gio de lai mot nextDueDate da tien nhung khong co giao dich tuong ung ('phantom advancement').

theoryBridge.note: Transaction/Query patterns - cach mot @Transactional method hoac roll back toan bo hoac khong roll back gi, ap dung truc tiep de chung minh khong co phantom advancement.

instructions: Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/recurring/RecurringGenerationFailureTest.java.

Dung mot diem mo rong cua service (vi du mot protected hook duoc goi giua create() va advanceNextDueDate(), chi tro thanh 'nem loi' trong lop test con/mock) de gia lap crash NGAY SAU khi giao dich da duoc tao nhung TRUOC khi nextDueDate tien.

Assert: sau khi generate() nem loi, nextDueDate cua template VAN LA gia tri cu (chua tien) - va vi ca method la mot @Transactional don vi, giao dich vua tao trong lan goi that bai do cung bi roll back (kiem tra lai bang mot query rieng ngoai transaction that bai).

Viet mot kich ban 'chay ca thang': mot template MONTHLY co nextDueDate lui vai ky trong qua khu, goi generate() lap lai (vi du trong vong lap cho toi khi nextDueDate khong con o qua khu) - assert so luong giao dich sinh ra dung bang so ky da qua, va moi giao dich co sourceRef phan biet nhau (theo tung ngay den han khac nhau).
Chay lai toan bo suite de xac nhan khong co gi khac bi anh huong.

run.expectedResult: BUILD SUCCESS - RecurringGenerationFailureTest pass va toan bo suite van xanh.
run.explanation: Xac nhan tinh nguyen tu that su (khong phai gia dinh) va viec sinh nhieu ky lien tiep dung so luong, dung sourceRef.

commonErrors.symptom: Test 'chung minh' atomicity bang cach doc lai template trong CUNG mot @Transactional test method ma khong that su kiem tra database sau rollback
commonErrors.likelyCause: De hon la mock/gia lap that bai that su o tang giao dich.
commonErrors.fix: Neu test khong buoc mot roi-tay-that-su o giua create() va advance, no chi kiem tra logic Java, khong kiem tra ranh gioi @Transactional that su - dung mot hook duoc thiet ke rieng cho test (TEST_ONLY) de gia lap dung diem that bai.

Day la ranh gioi thiet ke quan trong nhat cua ca task - de bi cam do 'tong quat hoa cho linh hoat' (mot bieu thuc boolean tuy y, mot ham danh gia dong) se bien Spendwise thanh mot workflow engine, dieu ma D10/R-DEP-2 tu choi ro rang.

Thu tu toan phan giua cac rule: so sanh priority truoc, dung id lam khoa phu khi priority bang nhau (giong da khoa boi test) - khong bao gio dua vao thu tu tra ve tu database.

run.expectedResult: BUILD SUCCESS - CategorizationRuleTest pass.

Response la record, khong phai entity (R16, R17).

guidedSteps.title: Diem dung: rule da luu duoc voi thu tu xac dinh, chua co gi ap dung chung
guidedSteps.goal: Xac nhan CategorizationRule luu dung dieu kien + category dich + priority + enabled, UNIQUE (user_id, priority) that su duoc database chan, va CRUD hoat dong voi ownership - nhung chua co bat ky giao dich nao tung duoc mot rule anh huong, do la task-rule-engine ke tiep.

guidedSteps.title: Viet test that bai: rule priority-1 thang, khong-khop giu category thu cong, rule tat khong duoc xet
guidedSteps.goal: RuleEngineTest chot: voi ba rule cung khop mot mo ta, ket qua LUON la category cua rule priority cao nhat (so nho nhat), lap lai nhieu lan cho ket qua giong het nhau; mot mo ta khong khop rule nao giu nguyen category da gan thu cong; rule bi disable khong bao gio duoc xet - tat ca fail dung ly do vi engine chua ton tai.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Day la 'invariant 9' cua blueprint: cung dau vao, cung thu tu rule, cung ket qua - moi lan. Neu engine khong deterministic (vi du dua vao thu tu tra ve khong dam bao cua mot Set), hai lan chay giong het nhau co the ra hai category khac nhau, va do la mot loi rat kho tai hien.

theoryBridge.note: Strategy pattern - engine se chon implementation matcher theo du lieu (loai dieu kien), khong phai mot if/else-if dai; test can chuan bi truoc it nhat hai loai dieu kien khac nhau de chung minh dieu do.
Test-first cho mot thuoc tinh deterministic - viet 'lap lai nhieu lan cho cung ket qua' truoc khi co implementation.

instructions: Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/rule/RuleEngineTest.java.

Test 1: seed 3 rule cung khop mot mo ta giao dich, voi priority 1/2/3 tro toi 3 category dich khac nhau - goi engine nhieu lan (vi du 5 lan lien tiep) va assert MOI lan deu tra ve dung category cua rule priority 1.
Test 2: seed mot mo ta KHONG khop rule nao, giao dich da co category duoc gan thu cong tu truoc - assert category thu cong giu nguyen, engine khong ghi de.
Test 3: mot rule bi disable (enabled = false) dung le se khop - assert engine bo qua no hoan toan (khong tra ve category cua rule do).

guidedSteps.title: Tu viet RuleEngine (Strategy-shaped) va noi vao TransactionCreationService
guidedSteps.goal: RuleEngine.apply(description, userId) duyet cac rule enabled cua user THEO DUNG THU TU PRIORITY (tu repository, khong sort lai o Java), tra ve category cua rule khop dau tien qua mot tap RuleConditionMatcher (Strategy); TransactionCreationService goi engine NGAY TRONG @Transactional method cua chinh no, va CHI khi giao dich chua co category thu cong.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: day-05's Strategy la hinh dang bat buoc: mot interface RuleConditionMatcher, moi loai dieu kien mot implementation - khong phai mot chuoi if (type == CONTAINS) {...} else if (type == EQUALS) {...} phinh to moi khi them loai dieu kien moi. ADR-006 tu choi kien truc su kien/async cho viec nay: engine chay DONG BO, trong CUNG giao dich database voi viec tao Transaction, de mot loi trong engine roll back ca viec tao thay vi de lai mot giao dich 'nua-categorized'.

learnerAction.goal: Viet RuleEngine.java, mot hoac nhieu RuleConditionMatcher implementation (mot cho moi RuleConditionType) trong com.spendwise.rule, va sua TransactionCreationService de goi engine khi tao mot giao dich khong-phai-transfer va chua co category.
constraints: RuleEngine chi doc rule (qua repository, ORDER BY priority) va doc/danh gia tung dieu kien qua cac RuleConditionMatcher - no khong goi bat ky subsystem nghiep vu nao khac (budget/recurring/dashboard) - chi la mot consumer chi-doc (R-DEP-4).
Moi RuleConditionType co MOT RuleConditionMatcher rieng (Strategy, day-05) - RuleEngine chon matcher theo type cua dieu kien, khong viet if/else-if theo type ngay trong engine.

Engine tra ve category cua RULE KHOP DAU TIEN theo thu tu priority (rule co priority nho nhat trong danh sach da sap theo priority) - dung ORDER BY tu repository, khong Collections.sort/HashSet lam mat thu tu.

Trong TransactionCreationService, engine CHI duoc goi khi command khong phai TRANSFER_IN/TRANSFER_OUT VA category chua duoc nguoi dung gan thu cong (category == null) - category thu cong luon thang, khong bao gio bi engine ghi de.

Loi goi engine phai nam TRONG cung @Transactional method voi viec tao Transaction, goi dong bo (khong @TransactionalEventListener, khong @Async, khong dispatch su kien) - mot loi trong engine phai roll back ca viec tao (R19, ADR-006).
Engine CHI thay doi category cua giao dich dang duoc tao - khong bao gio dung toi amount, date, balance, hay bat ky Transaction nao khac.
Mot rule co category dich khong con ton tai (khong resolve duoc) bi bo qua an toan (fail soft) - khong lam that bai viec tao giao dich.
hints: RuleConditionMatcher co the co dang boolean matches(RuleCondition condition, String description) va boolean supports(RuleConditionType type) - engine chon matcher dau tien co supports(type) == true cho tung rule.
Neu category dich cua rule khong con resolve duoc (fail soft), coi rule do nhu 'khong khop' va tiep tuc voi rule priority tiep theo, khong dung lai.

run.expectedResult: BUILD SUCCESS - RuleEngineTest pass va TransactionCreationServiceTest van xanh (khong bi pha vo boi viec noi engine vao).
run.explanation: Xac nhan engine deterministic dung thu tu priority va viec noi vao creation flow khong lam hong hanh vi da co.

commonErrors.symptom: Ap dung rule trong mot @TransactionalEventListener(phase = AFTER_COMMIT) hoac dispatch qua @Async
commonErrors.likelyCause: Cam giac 'tach rieng' viec categorize khoi viec tao giao dich se 'sach' hon.
commonErrors.fix: ADR-006 tu choi kien truc su kien cho viec nay - neu engine that bai sau khi giao dich da commit, ban co mot giao dich ton tai vinh vien voi category sai/thieu ma khong co gi sua. Engine phai chay dong bo, trong cung transaction.

commonErrors.symptom: Viet RuleEngine voi mot chuoi if (type == RuleConditionType.CONTAINS) {...} else if (type == RuleConditionType.EQUALS) {...} thay vi cac RuleConditionMatcher rieng
commonErrors.likelyCause: Voi chi hai loai dieu kien, if/else co ve du gon.
commonErrors.fix: day-05's Strategy la yeu cau ro rang cua task nay - moi loai dieu kien them vao sau nay (V0.8's import co the can them loai moi) chi can them mot implementation, khong sua engine.

guidedSteps.title: Viet test chung minh engine khong dung toi tien va category-bi-xoa duoc bo qua an toan
guidedSteps.goal: RuleEngineBoundaryTest chung minh amount/direction/occurredOn/balances khong doi sau khi engine ap dung mot rule, va mot rule co category dich khong con resolve duoc bi bo qua ma khong lam that bai viec tao giao dich - toan bo suite van pass.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Engine co ban kinh anh huong CHINH XAC bang mot truong tren mot ban ghi moi - buoc nay bien dieu do thanh mot bang chung chay duoc, khong phai mot loi hua trong comment, va kiem chung ca hai truong hop bien (rule tat, category chet) khong lam sup ca luong tao giao dich.
instructions: Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/rule/RuleEngineBoundaryTest.java.

Test 1: tao mot giao dich qua TransactionCreationService.create(...) voi mot rule khop se gan category X - ghi lai amount/direction/occurredOn/so du tai khoan TRUOC va SAU, assert tat ca deu giu nguyen NGOAI TRU category cua chinh giao dich vua tao; khong Transaction nao khac bi dung toi.

Test 2: tao mot rule co category dich la mot ma khong con ton tai trong tap category song (dung constructor TEST_ONLY neu CategorizationRule co cung cap, danh rieng cho tinh huong nay vi khong co con duong production nao xoa duoc category) - assert viec tao giao dich VAN thanh cong (engine bo qua rule nay, khong nem loi), va giao dich giu category = null (chua phan loai): con duong tao giao dich noi bo cho phep category null (constructor 3-tham so tu V0.1), dung y het nhu mot giao dich nhap tay khong khop rule nao. KHONG duoc them mot hang so Category 'chua phan loai' gia de tranh null - null CHINH LA cach mo hinh canonical bieu dien 'chua phan loai'.
Chay lai toan bo suite mot lan nua de xac nhan V0.7 hoan chinh khong pha vo bat ky gi cua V0.1-V0.6.

run.expectedResult: BUILD SUCCESS - RuleEngineBoundaryTest pass, toan bo suite van xanh.

guidedSteps.goal: Xac nhan RuleEngine ap dung rule khop-dau-tien theo dung priority, deterministic, khong bao gio ghi de category thu cong, va chi dung toi category cua giao dich dang tao - khong gi khac trong he thong bi anh huong.

guidedSteps.goal: DashboardReadServiceTest seed mot thang giao dich da biet qua TransactionCreationService.create(...) va assert tong income/expense cung breakdown theo category cua DashboardReadService khop dung SUM tinh tay - fail dung ly do vi service chua ton tai.

Seed mot thang giao dich da biet cho mot user (vai INCOME, vai EXPENSE thuoc it nhat hai category khac nhau) qua TransactionCreationService.create(...), va vai giao dich O THANG KHAC hoac CUA USER KHAC de chung minh phep loc dung (khong roi thang, khong roi user).

instructions: Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/category/CategoryCacheTest.java trong package com.spendwise.category; annotate @SpringBootTest(classes = {CacheConfig.class, CategoryService.class}) de Spring boot mot context toi thieu va ap dung proxy cache that - KHONG viet unit test kieu new CategoryService(mock) vi khi do @Cacheable khong bao gio duoc ap dung.

Khai bao @MockBean CategoryRepository, @Autowired CategoryService va @Autowired CacheManager; o dau moi test goi cacheManager.getCache(CacheConfig.CATEGORIES_CACHE).clear() de moi test bat dau voi cache sach.

Test hit: when(categoryRepository.findAll(Sort.by("code"))).thenReturn(List.of(Category.FOOD, Category.SALARY)); goi categoryService.list() hai lan, assertEquals ket qua hai lan bang nhau, roi verify(categoryRepository, times(1)).findAll(Sort.by("code")) - lan doc thu hai phai lay tu cache, khong query lai.

Test evict: stub findAll tra ve hai ket qua khac nhau qua hai lan goi (thenReturn(List.of(Category.FOOD)).thenReturn(List.of(Category.FOOD, Category.SALARY))), stub existsById("SALARY") tra false va save(any) tra lai chinh argument; assert list() dau = [FOOD], goi categoryService.add("SALARY"), assert list() ke tiep = [FOOD, SALARY], roi verify(categoryRepository, times(2)).findAll(Sort.by("code")) - evict da xoa entry 'all' nen lan doc sau query lai va thay ket qua moi.

Chay verify command; test phai fail dung ly do: CacheConfig chua ton tai (loi bien dich) hoac @Cacheable chua duoc dat nen lan doc thu hai van goi lai findAll va verify times(1) that bai - KHONG duoc fail vi ly do khac.

instructions: Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/account/BalanceReconciliationJobTest.java trong package com.spendwise.account; annotate @SpringBootTest va @Transactional - can DB that + cac repository/bean, moi test tu rollback.

Autowire cac bean can dung: AccountRepository, TransactionCreationService, BalanceReconciliationJob (chua ton tai - day chinh la ly do test fail o buoc nay), JdbcTemplate, UserRepository, va jakarta.persistence.EntityManager.

Viet helper saveAccount(String opening): tao chu so huu bang userRepository.save(new AppUser("owner-" + UUID.randomUUID(), "hash")).id(), roi tra ve accountRepository.saveAndFlush(new Account(ownerId, "Recon " + UUID.randomUUID(), AccountType.CASH, new Money(opening))).

Test 1 (consistent): saveAccount("100.00"), them mot giao dich INCOME 40.00 qua transactionCreationService.create(new TransactionCreationCommand(account, TransactionType.INCOME, new Money("40.00"), Category.SALARY, "TEST:job-income"), account.userId()); assert job.detectDrift() khong co phan tu nao co accountId bang account.id() (ledger khop nen khong drift).

Test 2 (detect dung account): tao clean = saveAccount("50.00") va drifted = saveAccount("200.00"); lam lech NGOAI duong canonical bang jdbcTemplate.update("update accounts set balance_amount = ? where id = ?", new BigDecimal("999.00"), drifted.id()); goi entityManager.clear() de bo cache tang mot; assert danh sach mismatches co chua drifted.id() va KHONG chua clean.id().

Test 3 (khong ghi): saveAccount("100.00"), lam lech balance_amount xuong 77.00 bang jdbcTemplate.update; entityManager.clear(); goi job.reconcile(); doc lai balance_amount bang jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(...) va assert no van la 77.00 (dung compareTo == 0) - job phat hien nhung khong sua.

instructions: Tao file src/test/java/com/spendwise/shared/ArchitectureInvariantTest.java trong package com.spendwise.shared - dung JUnit 5 (org.junit.jupiter.api.Test, org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName), tuyet doi khong @SpringBootTest, khong @Autowired, khong context nao.

R2: viet test @DisplayName("R2: Money equality is value-based (compareTo == 0), not BigDecimal.equals scale-sensitivity"). Tao new Money("10.0") va new Money("10.00"); truoc het assertNotEquals(new BigDecimal("10.0"), new BigDecimal("10.00")) de chung minh cai bay scale cua BigDecimal that su ton tai; roi assertEquals(hai Money) va assertEquals(hashCode cua chung); cuoi cung assertNotEquals(new Money("10.00"), new Money("10.01")). Money.equals hien so sanh currency + amount.compareTo == 0 nen test pass - muc dich la KHOA hop dong do lai.

R5: viet test @DisplayName("R5: division pins an explicit scale AND RoundingMode - the unrounded form throws"). Lay BigDecimal ten = new BigDecimal("10.00") va three = new BigDecimal("3"); assertThrows(ArithmeticException.class, () -> ten.divide(three)) - chia khong scale/mode tren thuong vo han tuan hoan phai nem; roi ten.divide(three, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP) phai compareTo == 0 voi new BigDecimal("3.33"); cuoi cung assertEquals(2, new Money("5").amount().scale()) va cho new Money("5.1") vi Money setScale(2, HALF_UP) o constructor.

R7: viet test @DisplayName("R7: a Transaction needs a strictly positive amount and a TYPED direction; zero/negative rejected"). Tao Account account = new Account(UUID.randomUUID(), "Cash", AccountType.CASH, new Money("100.00")); tao Transaction income = new Transaction(account, TransactionType.INCOME, new Money("40.00")), assert income.type() == INCOME va income.amount().amount().signum() > 0; lam tuong tu cho TransactionType.EXPENSE (so tien van luu duong, khong bi phu dinh). Roi assertThrows(InvalidAmountException.class, () -> new Transaction(account, EXPENSE, new Money("0.00"))) va cho new Money("-5.00").

Chay verify - hau het assertion se pass vi code da dung: day khong phai TDD cho code moi ma la chot bat bien len code san co. Dieu quan trong la neu ban tam thoi lam hong mot rule trong nhanh nhap (vi du sua Money.equals thanh this.amount.equals(other.amount)) thi dung mot test R2 do fail, khong phai test khac. Suite khong them mot dong production code nao.

commonErrors.symptom: Test R2 duoc viet bang assertEquals tren BigDecimal (hoac dung new Money("10.0").amount().equals(...)) va ket qua fail bat ngo tren '10.0' vs '10.00'.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Quen rang BigDecimal.equals nhay cam voi scale: '10.0' co scale 1, '10.00' co scale 2 nen equals tra false du gia tri bang nhau.
commonErrors.fix: Chot R2 tren Money (so sanh theo gia tri qua compareTo == 0), va giu assertNotEquals tren BigDecimal tho lam bang chung cho chinh cai bay ma R2 ne tranh. So sanh tien te luon qua Money/compareTo, khong bao gio qua BigDecimal.equals.

Khong them mot dong production code nao. Neu mot bat bien can hook production moi test duoc thi do la design smell can ghi lai, khong phai hook can them.
Khong dua ra cong (gate) phan tram coverage - coverage la chi bao, khong phai cong (day-28 blk-32 / JaCoCo chi bao cao).

Bo qua field.isSynthetic() va Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers()) khi duyet Category, neu khong cac hang so static VALUES/BY_CODE/FOOD... se gay nhieu cho test R11.

instructions: Mo pom.xml va xac nhan (hoac them neu thieu) ba dependency scope test: org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-testcontainers, org.testcontainers:junit-jupiter, org.testcontainers:postgresql - deu KHONG ghi the <version>, de Spring Boot BOM quan ly phien ban tuong thich (giong cach spring-boot-starter-test da lam).
Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/IntegrationTestBase.java trong package com.spendwise, gan @SpringBootTest va @Testcontainers len class.

Khai bao mot truong static @Container: static final PostgreSQLContainer<?> POSTGRES = new PostgreSQLContainer<>("postgres:16-alpine") - static de container chay len mot lan va cac subclass dung chung (day-29), image chot dung postgres:16-alpine theo constraint.

Viet mot static method gan @DynamicPropertySource nhan DynamicPropertyRegistry: registry.add("spring.datasource.url", POSTGRES::getJdbcUrl), va tuong tu username/password - dang truyen method-reference nen Spring goi chung SAU khi container start, dung luc dung context.

Trong cung method do, giu spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto la "validate" (khong doi thanh create/update): mapping JPA phai duoc doi soat vao schema Flyway da migrate, khong bao gio de Hibernate tu sinh schema. Va bom app.jwt.secret mot gia tri du dai (>=32 byte cho HS256) vi context can no de boot du suite nay khong dung toi JWT.

Them mot smoke @Test: autowire JdbcTemplate, queryForObject dem tu information_schema.tables where table_schema='public' and table_name='transactions', assertEquals(1, ...) - chung minh Flyway da tao bang transactions tren engine that.
Chay .\mvnw.cmd '-Dtest=IntegrationTestBase' test: lan dau se keo image postgres:16-alpine (can Docker daemon dang chay), container start, Flyway migrate, ddl-auto: validate pass, smoke test xanh.

commonErrors.symptom: Chay -Dtest=IntegrationTestBase bao 'No tests were executed' hoac Surefire fail vi khong tim thay test nao.
commonErrors.likelyCause: IntegrationTestBase chi la lop nen (@SpringBootTest + @Container) ma khong co @Test nao, nen khi loc dung ten no thi Surefire khong co gi de chay.
commonErrors.fix: Giu dung smoke @Test schemaExposesTheTransactionsTableAfterMigrations trong base: no vua chung minh base thuc su boot len container va migrate xong, vua khien lan chay loc co it nhat mot test.

commonErrors.symptom: Test bao loi kieu 'Could not find a valid Docker environment' hoac treo o buoc keo image.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Docker daemon chua chay - Testcontainers can mot Docker engine that de dung container postgres:16-alpine.
commonErrors.fix: Khoi dong Docker Desktop truoc khi chay; day chinh la cai gia cua su trung thuc - khac voi H2, suite nay chay dung engine that nen phu thuoc Docker.

guidedSteps.goal: MoneyPathIntegrationTest (extends IntegrationTestBase) chung minh bon tinh chat qua chinh cac service canonical, khong mock: TransactionCreationService.create luu dung mot dong voi sourceRef cua no (R20); mot transfer that bai giua chung (dich khac loai tien) de lai ZERO dong va so du khong doi (R21); re-import cung mot statement them ZERO giao dich va bao ca hai dong la DUPLICATE (R22 idempotency); hai thread dua cung (user_id, source_ref) chi commit dung mot dong (R22 arbitration tai constraint).
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Slice test chung minh tung tang rieng le, nhung duong tien - creation service, transfer, import idempotency, phan xu constraint - chinh la hanh vi lien-tang ma thay the in-memory noi doi. R21: neu transfer khong nguyen tu, chan no (debit) da tru so du con chan co (credit) fail thi tien bi pha huy am tham; test buoc dich phai la EUR de credit fail SAU debit, chung minh rollback keo ca hai chan ve. R22: neu khong co UNIQUE (user_id, source_ref) lam chot cuoi, khe hop check-then-act cho hai thread cung sourceRef commit ca hai, nhan doi giao dich - chi engine that voi UNIQUE that moi bay lo dieu nay.

theoryBridge.note: Testcontainers cho phep chay duong tien tren Postgres that: chi engine that co UNIQUE (user_id, source_ref) va ten constraint uq_txn_source_ref moi phan xu duoc cuoc dua hai thread mot cach trung thuc - H2/in-memory khong tai hien dung, nen R22 chi co the chung minh o day.

Kim tu thap test: integration test o dinh chay ca stack qua service that; seed du lieu qua fixture hoac dung service canonical (TransactionCreationService, ImportService.importCsv), tuyet doi khong mock chinh duong minh dang di kiem chung.

learnerAction.goal: Viet src/test/java/com/spendwise/MoneyPathIntegrationTest.java extends IntegrationTestBase, autowire cac repository va service that (UserRepository, AccountRepository, TransactionRepository, TransactionCreationService, TransferService, ImportService, ImportRowRepository), va viet bon @Test chung minh R20 tao canonical, R21 transfer rollback khi fail, R22 re-import them zero va bao DUPLICATE, R22 dua hai thread commit dung mot dong - moi test seed owner+account qua service/repository that.
constraints: KHONG mock TransactionCreationService, TransferService hay ImportService trong suite nay - suite ton tai chinh xac de kiem chung duong that; seed du lieu qua fixture hoac qua chinh service canonical, khong bao gio bypass.

Test R20: goi transactionCreationService.create(new TransactionCreationCommand(account, TransactionType.EXPENSE, new Money("40.00"), Category.FOOD, "TEST:canonical-1"), ownerId) roi assert transactionRepository.findAllByAccountIdWithReferences(account.id()) co dung 1 dong va sourceRef() bang "TEST:canonical-1".

Test R21: tao source la USD va destination la EUR, goi transferService.transfer voi Money USD; assertThrows CurrencyMismatchException, roi assert ca hai account co 0 dong giao dich VA so du hai ben giu nguyen (100.00 USD / 20.00 EUR) - dich phai khac loai tien de credit fail SAU debit, chung minh rollback nguyen tu.

Test R22 idempotency: ghi mot file CSV (header occurredOn,amount,currency,description,sourceTxnId + 2 dong) qua @TempDir, goi importService.importCsv HAI lan; assert lan dau co 2 dong OK, lan hai co 2 dong DUPLICATE (dem qua importRowRepository.findAllByBatchIdOrderByRowNumberAsc + ImportRow::status), va tong so giao dich van la 2.

Test R22 concurrency: dung ExecutorService 2 luong submit hai lan goi create() cung mot contendedRef; sau khi ca hai xong, assert dung 1 dong co sourceRef do trong DB, dung 1 lan thanh cong va it nhat 1 lan bi tu choi (RuntimeException/SourceRefConflictException) - khong am tham nhan doi.
R8: sau moi thao tac, doi soat so du la nguon su that duy nhat - o test R21 phai assert lai balance() cua ca hai account, khong chi dem so dong.
hints: seedOwner() gon: userRepository.save(new AppUser("user-" + UUID.randomUUID(), "hash")).id() - moi test mot owner rieng de trong container dung chung khong dam vao nhau.

Vi transferService.transfer goi TransactionCreationService.create hai lan trong CUNG mot @Transactional, khi chan credit nem CurrencyMismatchException thi ca transaction Spring rollback - do chinh la R21; ban chi can assert trang thai sau, khong can tu quan ly transaction.

Cuoc dua R22: bat RuntimeException chung trong Runnable (ke thua se la SourceRefConflictException hoac wrapper), dem successes vs rejections bang AtomicInteger, va goi Future.get() cho ca hai truoc khi assert de chac ca hai luong da chay xong.
Dem DUPLICATE bang cach loc status cua cac ImportRow theo batchId, khong dem giao dich - vi lan re-import van tao ImportRow (voi status DUPLICATE) nhung KHONG tao Transaction moi.

commonErrors.fix: Suite nay ton tai dung de chay duong that tren engine that; mock chinh service dang kiem chung lam rong nghia bai test. Seed qua fixture hoac service canonical, khong bao gio bypass (day-28).

guidedSteps.title: Them MDC traceId cho log moi request qua servlet filter chay mot lan
guidedSteps.goal: TraceIdFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter dat mot traceId (UUID) vao MDC dau moi request va clear trong finally; application.properties co logging.pattern.level chua %X{traceId}; TraceIdFilterTest chung minh hai dong log trong mot request chia se cung traceId va id da bi xoa sau request.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Mot request, mot traceId: structured logging chi thuc su dung duoc khi moi dong log cua cung mot request mang cung correlation id. Neu MDC.remove khong nam trong finally, worker thread trong thread-pool tai su dung se giu traceId cu va gan nham no cho request tiep theo - do la kieu ro ri MDC kinh dien lam sai ca chuoi truy vet. Neu pattern log khong chua %X{traceId} thi id sinh ra chang bao gio duoc in ra.

theoryBridge.note: MDC traceId cho moi request qua filter/interceptor duoc day o blk-4-7: dat id vao MDC dau request, in qua %X{traceId}, va clear cuoi request de id khong ro ri sang request ke.

learnerAction.goal: Viet src/main/java/com/spendwise/shared/TraceIdFilter.java extends OncePerRequestFilter dat traceId (UUID) vao MDC dau moi request va clear trong finally; them logging.pattern.level=%5p [traceId=%X{traceId}] vao application.properties; viet src/test/java/com/spendwise/shared/TraceIdFilterTest.java chung minh hai dong log trong mot request chia se cung traceId va MDC da rong sau request.
constraints: Filter phai extends OncePerRequestFilter (chay dung mot lan moi request), gan @Component va @Order(Integer.MIN_VALUE) de chay dau tien nen traceId co mat cho moi thu downstream.
MDC.remove(TRACE_ID) phai nam trong finally block bao quanh filterChain.doFilter(...) - neu khong, thread tai su dung giu traceId cu va gan nham cho request sau (ro ri MDC).
Khai bao hang so public static final String TRACE_ID = "traceId" de test va logging pattern cung tham chieu dung mot key.
logging.pattern.level phai chua %X{traceId} thi id moi xuat hien tren moi dong log.
Test la unit thuan (khong @SpringBootTest, khong DB): dung MockHttpServletRequest/MockHttpServletResponse va mot MockFilterChain doc MDC.get(TraceIdFilter.TRACE_ID) hai lan trong mot request.
hints: Cai dat logic vao doFilterInternal: MDC.put dau, filterChain.doFilter o giua, MDC.remove trong finally.
Override MockFilterChain.doFilter de add MDC.get(TraceIdFilter.TRACE_ID) hai lan vao mot List - mo phong hai statement log trong cung mot request.
Assert hai gia tri quan sat bang nhau va non-null trong request, roi assertNull(MDC.get(TRACE_ID)) sau khi filter tra ve; UUID.randomUUID().toString() la cach don gian sinh traceId.

commonErrors.symptom: Log cua request sau in ra traceId cua request truoc, hoac hai request khac nhau lai cung mot traceId.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Dat MDC.put nhung khong clear, hoac clear ngoai finally nen khi doFilter nem exception thi id khong bi xoa - thread tai su dung mang id cu.
commonErrors.fix: Bao filterChain.doFilter trong try va MDC.remove(TRACE_ID) trong finally - id luon duoc xoa cuoi moi request du thanh cong hay loi.

guidedSteps.title: Lam duong async notification bounded voi AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler sau khi batch terminal
guidedSteps.goal: AsyncConfig co bean ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bounded (queueCapacity tuong minh, CallerRunsPolicy) va AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler log that bai; ImportNotification.notifyBatchComplete la @Async void tren executor do; ImportService.importCsv goi no SAU vong lap ghi row (batch terminal), khong trong transaction row, va van return ImportBatch dong bo 200; ImportNotificationTest chung minh notification fire ma khong doi batch state.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Chu de async day-25 tim thay artifact cua no: mot side effect fire-and-forget sau khi batch finalize. R19 giu side effect ngoai transaction row - neu dispatch trong vong lap/trong transaction cua mot row thi notification bi ghep vao commit va co the giu DB connection qua ranh gioi async. R22 giu import tuan tu. Queue vo han bien fire-and-forget thanh nguy co OOM duoi tai; thieu AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler thi exception trong task void bien mat khong dau vet.

theoryBridge.note: @Async can executor BOUNDED tuong minh va AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler bat buoc cho method void - khong co handler thi loi trong task fire-and-forget bi nuot im lang.
after-commit ordering: notification chi dispatch khi batch da terminal (het vong lap, moi row da commit rieng), khong bao gio ben trong transaction cua mot row (R19).

run.expectedResult: BUILD SUCCESS - toan bo test/kiem tra trong scope cua buoc nay pass; khong test nao khac trong suite bi vo.
run.explanation: Chay verify command canonical cua buildStep trong learner workspace de xac nhan buoc da xong dung.

learnerAction.goal: Viet AsyncConfig (@Configuration @EnableAsync implements AsyncConfigurer) voi mot @Bean ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bounded ten NOTIFICATION_EXECUTOR va getAsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler log that bai; ImportNotification @Component voi @Async(NOTIFICATION_EXECUTOR) void notifyBatchComplete(UUID batchId) + dispatchedCount() de test await; goi importNotification.notifyBatchComplete(batch.id()) trong ImportService.importCsv SAU vong lap ghi row roi van return batch; ImportNotificationTest @SpringBootTest chung minh 3 tinh chat.
constraints: Executor phai BOUNDED: setQueueCapacity tuong minh (dry-run dung 50), core/max pool huu han, setRejectedExecutionHandler CallerRunsPolicy tao backpressure thay vi drop viec am tham - queue vo han la nguy co OOM.
@Async method tra void, KHONG viet gi vao DB; phai cai getAsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler (log.warn) vi khong co handler thi exception trong task void bien mat khong dau vet (day-25).
Dispatch notifyBatchComplete SAU khi batch terminal (het vong lap row) trong ImportService.importCsv, KHONG BAO GIO ben trong transaction cua mot row (R19; day-27 after-commit).
Khong doi hop dong HTTP: importCsv van return ImportBatch dong bo (200 summary), khong 202 (ADR-012).
Async side effect khong duoc doi batch state - test assert so row va status khong doi sau khi notification fire.
dispatchedCount qua AtomicInteger chi de test await deterministic, khong dung cho business logic.
hints: @Async(AsyncConfig.NOTIFICATION_EXECUTOR) tro dung ten bean executor da khai bao.
Test @SpringBootTest await bang vong poll dispatchedCount() den mot deadline (vi du 5s), tranh Thread.sleep co dinh gay flaky.
AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler la lambda (throwable, method, params) -> log.warn(...) - log roi khong lan xa hon nen batch da commit khong the roll back.

commonErrors.symptom: Notification fire nhieu lan (moi row mot lan) hoac giu DB connection qua lau, hoac roll back anh huong batch.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Goi notifyBatchComplete ben trong vong lap ghi row / ben trong transaction row thay vi sau khi batch terminal.
commonErrors.fix: Goi mot lan duy nhat SAU vong lap khi batch da terminal (R19; day-27 after-commit) - side effect nam ngoai moi transaction row.

commonErrors.symptom: Mot loi trong task notification bien mat khong log, khong dau vet.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Khong cai getAsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler cho method @Async void.
commonErrors.fix: Cai AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler trong AsyncConfig de log that bai (day-25) - task void khong co return de propagate exception.

R20 doi moi hang tai chinh di qua duong chinh thong; o day con nghiem hon R20's test allowance - fixture cung khong duoc raw-insert su that tai chinh, de chinh cac duong chinh thong bi kiem chung. Neu fixture lay tat khap R8 projection bang raw insert thi bang chung dong se rong tue, vi vay phai gieo that qua create/import/generate.

instructions: Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/SeedHistoryFixture.java: mot lop test-only gieo lich su qua duong chinh thong, khong extends gi bat buoc nhung dung chung cac bean da autowired (TransactionCreationService, ImportService, RecurringGenerationService, AccountRepository, BudgetService/BudgetRepository, UserRepository).

Trong fixture: tao mot owner qua UserRepository.save, roi >=2 Account qua accountRepository.saveAndFlush (nhu BalanceReconciliationTest lam) voi openingBalance ro rang - reconciliation nhom theo account nen phai co it nhat hai account de chung minh khong lan so giua chung.

Gieo giao dich thu cong nhieu thang qua transactionCreationService.create(new TransactionCreationCommand(account, type, new Money(...), Category..., sourceRef, occurredOn), ownerId): moi command dat occurredOn tuong minh (dung constructor co LocalDate occurredOn) trai dai qua vai thang, moi sourceRef duy nhat (vi du TEST:seed:<n>), khong bao gio raw insert vao bang transactions.

Gieo mot import batch qua ImportService.importCsv(ownerId, accountId, fileName, csvFile): viet mot file CSV tam (@TempDir) vai dong hop le (co header, cot signed amount, mot vai dong co sourceTxnId de vao tier-1, vai dong khong de vao tier-2) - de import pipeline that tao cac hang, khong tu goi create thay no.

Gieo recurring qua recurringTransactionRepository.save mot RecurringTransaction co nextDueDate trong qua khu, roi goi recurringGenerationService.generateDue(ownerId, asOf) voi asOf = hom nay de sinh nhieu occurrence dung qua duong chinh thong (moi occurrence co sourceRef RECURRING:<id>:<dueDate>).
Gieo it nhat mot Budget qua duong binh thuong (BudgetService/repository) cho mot category va period trong khoang lich su, de buoc kiem toan SUM sau nay co budget that de doi chieu (R10 derived).

Tao src/test/java/com/spendwise/HardeningReconciliationTest.java: @SpringBootTest @Transactional, autowire fixture (hoac goi truc tiep cac buoc gieo) + BalanceReconciliationJob job; goi fixture gieo toan bo lich su roi assertTrue(job.detectDrift().isEmpty()) tren cac account vua gieo.

Chay verifyCommand: test nay phai fail dung ly do - hoac vi SeedHistoryFixture chua ton tai, hoac vi detectDrift() bao drift lo ra loi that trong duong chinh thong - KHONG duoc pass ngay bang cach raw-insert balance cho khop.

Tuyet doi khong sua production code o buoc nay va khong raw-insert su that tai chinh: fixture chi dung create/importCsv/generateDue; chinh sua projection (drift probe) neu can chi lam o repository-level trong test, giong task-scheduled-reconciliation, khong bao gio trong production.

guidedSteps.title: Kiem toan SUM tay doi chieu dashboard/statistics/budget va sua loi lo ra qua duong binh thuong
guidedSteps.goal: HardeningSumAuditTest tinh SUM tay tren lich su da gieo va khang dinh khop tuyet doi voi StatisticsService (totalIncome/totalExpense/spendingByCategory), DashboardReadService.forMonth va BudgetCalculationService.calculate; BalanceReconciliationJob bao zero drift; moi defect lo ra duoc sua qua duong binh thuong kem regression test; khong feature/endpoint/rule/architecture moi nao xuat hien.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Day la muc dich V1.0 goi trong mot buoc: chung minh moi con so dan xuat khop su that tinh tay tren lich su that, roi sua bat ky gi bang chung tim ra - chi qua duong binh thuong. R1 giu amount BigDecimal scale 2, R6 giu figures dan xuat tu ledger, R8 giu balance la projection (job doc lai, khong ghi de), R10 giu budget figures dan xuat khong luu. Mot nha tuyen dung soi portfolio se hoi 'lam sao ban biet no dung o quy mo?' - cau tra loi la day: SUM tay = dashboard = statistics = budget, va reconciliation zero drift.

theoryBridge.note: Stream API - filter theo TransactionType, groupingBy(Category), va BigDecimal reduce - la chinh engine StatisticsService dung; ban tay tinh lai bang cung phep de doi chieu totalIncome/totalExpense/spendingByCategory.

@Transactional(readOnly=true) va cac query repository theo khoang thoi gian/category (findAllByUserIdAndOccurredOnBetweenWithReferences, findAllByUserIdAndCategoryAndOccurredOnBetween) la nen cua BudgetCalculationService/DashboardReadService - hieu chung de tinh tay SUM cung pham vi period/category.

Doi chieu dung con so DAN XUAT (R6): goi StatisticsService/DashboardReadService/BudgetCalculationService that de lay figures, khong doc mot cot 'tong' luu san nao - vi khong ton tai cot nhu vay va khong duoc tao ra.

learnerAction.goal: Viet phan kien truc trong README.md (va dat cac ghi chu ADR chi tiet hon vao docs/architecture-notes.md): (1) ke hanh trinh V0.1 den V1.0; (2) liet ke invariant Constitution khop dung display name cua rule suite; (3) chep cac quyet dinh chinh; (4) mo ta mo hinh danh tinh import hai tier KEM gioi han reordering cua tier fallback - dung nhu code cong bo.
constraints: Danh sach invariant phai khop mot-doi-mot display name cua rule suite trong src/test/java/com/spendwise/shared/: R2 (Money equality value-based, khong BigDecimal.equals scale-sensitivity), R5 (division pin explicit scale VA RoundingMode, dang unrounded nem loi), R7 (Transaction can amount duong that su va huong typed; zero/negative bi tu choi), R10 (Budget chi luu limit, khong luu spent/remaining/percentage/status), R11 (chi Category duoc cache va no khong mang money figure), R24 (SecurityContextHolder doc o dung mot class CurrentUser, va foreign-owner la 404 khong 403). Moi rule da ghim phai duoc ke - khong bo sot, khong bia rule khong ton tai.

Chi cite rule id THUC (R1-R26) va quyet dinh ADR THUC. Khong bia kien truc: KHONG microservices, KHONG bank sync, KHONG claim universal dedup. App la single-user-per-deployment voi cot user_id tren moi bang so huu.

Mo hinh danh tinh import phai neu KEM GIOI HAN: tier-2 (fallback, khi row khong co source reference) dung baseFingerprint + occurrenceIndex 1-based dem theo THU TU FILE, ra sourceRef dang IMPORT:<baseFingerprint>|OCC:<index>. No stable khi re-import CUNG mot statement (cung thu tu file), NHUNG khong stable qua reordering tuy y cua mot file duoc dung lai - occurrenceIndex duoc recompute theo thu tu moi. Ghi thang cai gia nay, dung oversell dedup.

Tier-1 (uu tien, khi row co source reference on dinh) dung sourceRef = IMPORT:SRC:<sourceKey>:<accountId>:<normalize(sourceTxnId)> va la order-independent - phai phan biet ro voi tier-2. Constraint database do la V10__transaction_source_ref.sql: UNIQUE (user_id, source_ref) global tren toan ledger, kem backfill legacy sang MANUAL:<uuid>.

Concurrency model phai ghi R22: vong lap import la for-each tuan tu, cam parallelStream/parallel executor tren duong import vi occurrence counter cua RowIdentityService la order-derived (ImportService.importCsv nuoi RowIdentityService theo dung thu tu file).
Chi tai lieu: task nay khong doi production code nao ngoai README.md (va docs/architecture-notes.md, cac link/anh no tham chieu), khong them endpoint (R26: khong gi sau ky thuat cua day-30).
hints: Lay display name invariant tu @DisplayName trong ArchitectureInvariantTest (R2/R5/R7) va ArchitectureInvariantReadSideTest (R10/R11/R24) - chep dung y, dung tom tat lai thanh rule khac. Sau khi khop, doi chieu tung dong invariant voi tung @DisplayName de chac chan mot-doi-mot.

Cho quyet dinh no-202: ImportService KHONG @Transactional, moi row la mot transaction rieng qua ImportRowProcessor, response dong bo doi het cac row, chi co mot leg async la thong bao fire-and-forget dispatch SAU vong lap (khong bao gio trong row transaction - R19).

Cho AI boundary (ADR-016): day la ranh gioi advisory/hoan lai, KHONG phai tinh nang da ship - grep src/main khong co lop AI nao. Categorization that su la RuleEngine tat dinh (com.spendwise.rule.RuleEngine, priority-ordered CategorizationRule): TransactionCreationService.create chi tu gan category qua ruleEngine.categorize khi caller khong truyen category, category thu cong luon thang, va ket qua duoc gan inline ngay trong create() - khong co buoc AI goi y hay user accept.

Cho gioi han reordering: dien dat dung cai code cong bo - hai row du lieu giong het trong mot statement nhan OCC:1 va OCC:2 (hai danh tinh, nen hai giao dich); re-import cung statement recompute ca hai, va them 0 bao 2 DUPLICATE; nhung mot file dung lai theo thu tu khac thi OCC index recompute va co the khac - do la cai stable trong-statement nhung khong order-independent nhu tier-1.

docs/architecture-notes.md la file moi - dat o day cac ADR dai (canonical path la duong ghi duy nhat, per-row atomicity, no-202, 404-khong-403, AI boundary, mo hinh danh tinh) de README goc gon, README link toi no.

commonErrors.likelyCause: Muon phan portfolio nghe manh me hon, oversell kha nang dedup ma code khong co.
commonErrors.fix: Ghi dung nhu code cong bo: tier-2 stable khi re-import CUNG file (cung thu tu), nhung occurrenceIndex la order-derived nen khong stable qua reordering tuy y. Neu ngon ngu nghe nhu universal dedup, README dang noi doi ve code - viet cai gia ra thang.

instructions: Tao docs/demo-script.md (Markdown, khong phai production code - V1.0 chi chung minh va tai lieu hoa nhung gi da xay tu V0.1-V0.9, khong them endpoint moi theo R26).

Mo dau bang doan Setup: ghi lenh ./mvnw.cmd -DskipTests package roi docker compose up --build -d va docker compose ps, ghi ro app chi bat dau demo khi /actuator/health bao leg db UP; dat moc thoi gian du kien cho doan nay (vi du 0:00-1:30).

Doan Auth va Account: POST /api/auth/register roi POST /api/auth/login lay token, POST /api/accounts tao mot account; talking point ghi R24 - ownership doc SecurityContextHolder o dung mot class CurrentUser va moi query deu scope theo owner id.

Doan Category: chi ro category la danh sach seed co dinh (FOOD, TRANSPORT, HOUSING, ENTERTAINMENT, SALARY) doc qua GET /api/categories - KHONG co endpoint tao category, nen demo chon mot code seed san chu khong tao moi (trung thuc voi cai app that lam).

Doan Transactions: POST /api/transactions vai giao dich (income va expense) qua CreateTransactionRequest; talking point ghi R20 - moi Transaction di qua duong tao chinh tac TransactionCreationService.create va mang mot sourceRef (vi du MANUAL:<uuid>), khong bao gio insert thang vao repository.

Doan Import: chuan bi mot file CSV co (a) mot dong trung co y voi mot giao dich da co (dong nay phai mang CUNG sourceTxnId voi mot giao dich da co - chi tier 1 moi cho ket qua DUPLICATE; hai dong cung noi dung ma khong co sourceTxnId se vao tier 2 va CA HAI deu duoc import voi OCC index khac nhau) va (b) mot dong hong co y (thieu cot / so tien khong parse duoc); POST /api/imports voi accountId va file; talking point ghi R22 - moi dong la mot don vi atomic rieng, ket qua la dung mot trong OK/DUPLICATE/FAILED, dong hong ghi FAILED va khong chan dong khac.
Doan Import Report: GET /api/imports/{id} de doc summary OK/DUPLICATE/FAILED theo tung dong; noi ro batchId va rowNo chi de hien thi va bao loi, khong bao gio tham gia danh tinh dong (R22).

Doan Two-tier honesty: giai thich thang - mot dong co tham chieu nguon on dinh trung se bao DUPLICATE (tier 1), con hai dong noi dung y het nhau ma khong co tham chieu nguon thi CA HAI deu duoc import voi occurrence index khac nhau (OCC, tier 2), dung nhu ReImportIdempotencyTest chung minh.
Doan Budget: GET /api/budgets/{id}/calculation cho thay spent/remaining/percentage/status; talking point ghi R10 - cac so lieu nay duoc suy dien luc doc, khong bao gio luu tru.

Doan Dashboard: GET /api/dashboard?month=YYYY-MM cho thay tong income/expense, breakdown theo category, balance theo account, trang thai budget; talking point ghi R10 va R24 - moi so la derived va moi query scope theo owner.

Doan Re-import (idempotency): POST /api/imports lai dung file CSV do; talking point ghi R22 - lan re-import cong them ZERO giao dich, cac dong OK truoc gio bao DUPLICATE vi danh tinh duoc tai tao giong het (batchId/rowNo khong tham gia danh tinh); danh chu DUPLICATE ro rang trong tai lieu.
Doan Health/Docs: mo /actuator/health (bao db UP), /swagger-ui.html va /v3/api-docs do springdoc phuc vu - chung minh app san sang van hanh (day-30).

Doan Forced-failure (rollback): transfer la thao tac service-level @Transactional va KHONG co endpoint HTTP rieng trong ban build nay (R26 cam them endpoint moi), nen doan nay chung minh rollback bang cach CHAY TEST truc tiep truoc mat nguoi cham - .\mvnw.cmd '-Dtest=TransferServiceTest#rollsBackDebitWhenCreditLegFails' test (va MoneyPathIntegrationTest) - cho thay transfer khac tien te nem CurrencyMismatchException, cap TRANSFER_OUT/TRANSFER_IN chia chung mot transferRef, ca hai leg rollback trong MOT don vi @Transactional (R21/R20), so du hai account KHONG doi va khong co dong nao duoc ghi, dung nhu TransferServiceTest.rollsBackDebitWhenCreditLegFails khang dinh; ghi ro chu rollback va ghi chu 'transfer khong co REST endpoint - chung minh bang test' trong tai lieu. Thanh phan that bai kha kien qua HTTP tren app da dong goi la dong CSV hong o doan Import (FAILED, per-row R22).
Cuoi tai lieu: ghi bang moc thoi gian tong (moi doan may phut) sao cho tong khop cua so 10-15 phut, va mot dong ket noi bat: demo nay lam chieu sau cua project hien ra trong vai phut.

commonErrors.symptom: Kich ban ghi doan 'tao category moi' qua mot POST /api/categories, hoac giai thich rang hai dong noi dung giong het se bao DUPLICATE.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Gia dinh category la CRUD nhu account, va gia dinh 'giong het thi la trung' ma khong doc ky mo hinh hai tang.
commonErrors.fix: Category la seed co dinh, chi co GET /api/categories - chon code seed san. Hai dong giong het khong co tham chieu nguon deu duoc import (tier 2, OCC index khac nhau); chi dong co tham chieu nguon on dinh trung moi bao DUPLICATE (tier 1). Ke dung cau chuyen ReImportIdempotencyTest da chung minh.

commonErrors.symptom: Doan forced-failure viet kieu 'gia su o day co mot bug' hoac chi mo ta rollback bang loi ma khong chay that.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Nghi rang chi can noi ve rollback la du cho buoi bao ve.
commonErrors.fix: Ep mot that bai THAT bang cach chay TransferServiceTest.rollsBackDebitWhenCreditLegFails truc tiep: transfer khac tien te nem CurrencyMismatchException, R21 - transfer la mot don vi @Transactional nen ca hai leg rollback, so du khong doi. Transfer khong co REST endpoint (R26 cam them) nen chung minh bang test chay truoc mat, khong hand-waving; thanh phan failure kha kien qua HTTP la dong CSV hong (FAILED, R22).

Doan forced-failure chung minh R21 bang cach chay TransferServiceTest.rollsBackDebitWhenCreditLegFails (va MoneyPathIntegrationTest) truc tiep - transfer la @Transactional service-level, KHONG co REST endpoint tren app da dong goi (R26 cam them) nen khong GET so du qua HTTP; test cho thay transfer khac tien te nem CurrencyMismatchException va ca hai leg rollback trong mot don vi @Transactional, so du khong doi.
Khong sua production code, khong them endpoint moi (R26) - day chi la dien tap va ghi chu thoi gian vao docs/demo-script.md.
Ghi moc thoi gian that (timing) vao tai lieu sao cho tong khop cua so 10-15 phut.
hints: Neu docker compose ps chua healthy, cho /actuator/health bao db UP roi moi bat dau - dung dem thoi gian setup vao ngan sach demo.
De thay DUPLICATE ro rang, dung dung file CSV o lan import dau va lan re-import; danh tinh duoc tai tao giong het nen cac dong OK truoc gio bao DUPLICATE.

Doan forced-failure: chay .\mvnw.cmd '-Dtest=TransferServiceTest#rollsBackDebitWhenCreditLegFails' test - transfer hai account khac tien te (USD/EUR) nem CurrencyMismatchException va ca hai leg rollback; test tu assert so du khong doi, khong can GET qua HTTP vi transfer khong co REST endpoint.
Ghi moc thoi gian ngay khi dien tap that (vi du Setup 1:30, money path 6:00, import+re-import 3:00, failure 2:00) chu dung uoc luong sau.

guidedSteps.title: Dung bang bo ba con tro (code path - test - rule id) tren toan ma tran cau hoi bao ve
guidedSteps.goal: Tao docs/defense-audit.md: moi vung phong thu (money model R1/R2/R5, truth/projections R6/R7/R8, canonical path/identity R20/R22 + ADR-007, transfer R21, ownership R24/R25, schema discipline R3/R26, cache/async/scheduler R11/R19, token-issuance §6/R-DAY33, testing tiers ADR-014, AI boundary ADR-016) la mot hang co bo ba da kiem chung - duong dan code ton tai, test duoc trich chay pass, rule id trung dung ten hien thi @DisplayName cua suite.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Buoi bao ve cuoi hoi 'tai sao': tai sao Money so sanh bang compareTo chu khong BigDecimal.equals, tai sao import tra 201 dong bo chu khong 202, tai sao chu so hoi cham tai khoan nguoi khac tra 404 chu khong 403. Tra loi tu tri nho duoi ap luc thi hong; tra loi bang cach chi thang vao src/main/java/com/spendwise/shared/Money.java va test MoneyTest.treatsEquivalentScalesAsEqualMoney dang pass thi vung. R20 (moi duong tao giao dich la TransactionCreationService.create()), R22 (khong parallelStream tren duong import) va R24 (doc SecurityContextHolder o dung mot noi, foreign-owner ra 404) chinh la nhung 'tai sao' hay bi hoi nhat - bang nay bien Hien Phap tu thu duoc tuan theo thanh thu tu minh bao ve duoc.

theoryBridge.note: Final Defense: bang bo ba con tro nay chinh la vat pham chuan bi bao ve - moi cau hoi ma tran §19 co san mot vi tri tra loi da kiem chung thay vi mot cau tra loi thuoc long.

Testing Spring Boot: cot 'proving test' cua moi hang phai la mot test co that trong suite (vi du MoneyTest, TransferServiceTest, OwnershipTest, ReImportIdempotencyTest) da tung chay pass, khong phai mot cau mo ta chung chung.

run.command: if (-not (Test-Path 'docs\defense-audit.md')) { Write-Host 'audit missing'; exit 1 }; $c = Get-Content 'docs\defense-audit.md' -Raw; foreach ($k in 'R20','R22','R24','ADR-016') { if ($c -notmatch $k) { Write-Host "audit lacks area: $k"; exit 1 } }; Write-Host 'defense audit present'
run.expectedResult: BUILD SUCCESS - toan bo test/kiem tra trong scope cua buoc nay pass; khong test nao khac trong suite bi vo.

instructions: Tao file docs/defense-audit.md trong repo hoc (khong phai src) - day la vat pham san sang cuoi cung, viet sau buoi tap demo. Dat tieu de va mot bang co it nhat 4 cot: Vung (defense area), Code path, Proving test, Rule id / ADR.

Hang money model: code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/shared/Money.java; proving test src/test/java/com/spendwise/shared/MoneyTest.java (treatsEquivalentScalesAsEqualMoney chung minh so sanh bang compareTo == 0, rejectsCrossCurrencyArithmetic chan cong tru khac tien te); rule id R2 va R5 - lay dung ten hien thi tu ArchitectureInvariantTest @DisplayName ('R2: Money equality is value-based (compareTo == 0)...' va 'R5: division pins an explicit scale AND RoundingMode...').

Hang truth/projections: R7 (Transaction can amount duong that su + huong TYPED, zero/am bi tu choi) - code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/account/Transaction.java, proving test ArchitectureInvariantTest @DisplayName 'R7: a Transaction needs a strictly positive amount and a TYPED direction...'; bo sung hang R10 tu ArchitectureInvariantReadSideTest ('R10: Budget persists ONLY the limit...') cho ranh gioi 'khong luu figure phai suy dien'.

Hang canonical path va identity: code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/account/TransactionCreationService.java - method create() la duong tao giao dich duy nhat (R20), va rang buoc uq_txn_source_ref bat SourceRefConflictException; proving test src/test/java/com/spendwise/imports/SourceRefConstraintTest.java. Identity import: code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/imports/RowIdentityService.java (dinh dang IMPORT:<fingerprint>|OCC:<n>, occurrence counter la order-derived nen R22 cam parallelStream), proving test ReImportIdempotencyTest.tierTwoOccurrencePairStillDedupesWhenReimportedInReverseOrder va RowIdentityServiceTest.tier2AssignsDistinctSequentialOccurrenceIndicesInFileOrder; ghi kem ADR-007 (idempotency theo sourceRef).

Hang transfer model (R21): code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/account/TransferService.java - method transfer() la @Transactional, hai leg cung mot chu; proving test TransferServiceTest.rollsBackDebitWhenCreditLegFails (leg credit hong thi leg debit roll back) va createsLinkedTransferLegsAndMovesBothStoredBalances; ghi kem ADR-013.

Hang ownership (R24/R25): code path SecurityContextHolder doc o dung mot lop, truy cap tai khoan nguoi khac tra 404 chu khong 403; proving test src/test/java/com/spendwise/account/OwnershipTest.java (strangerGetsNotFoundForAnotherUsersAccount, accountListNeverIncludesAnotherUsersAccounts) va ArchitectureInvariantReadSideTest @DisplayName 'R24: SecurityContextHolder is read in exactly one class, and foreign-owner access is 404 not 403'.

Hang schema discipline (R3/R26): code path src/main/resources/db/migration (V1__init.sql toi V10__transaction_source_ref.sql, chi Flyway - khong ddl-auto sinh schema); proving test src/test/java/com/spendwise/account/SchemaValidationTest.java (bootsAgainstFlywayMigratedSchemaUnderDdlAutoValidate chung minh entity khop schema Flyway duoi validate, v4UserIdentityMigrationAppliedAndOwnershipColumnsAreForeignKeyed).

Hang cache/async/scheduler (R11/R19): R11 chi Category duoc cache va no khong mang figure tien te - proving test ArchitectureInvariantReadSideTest @DisplayName 'R11: the only cached type (Category) carries no money figure...' va CategoryCacheTest; R19 executor @Async phai bi chan bien (bounded) - code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/shared/AsyncConfig.java; scheduler la wiring thuan tren lich bounded - code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/recurring/RecurringScheduler.java (@Scheduled fixedDelayString, R20 khong them logic ghi moi).

Hang token-issuance timing (§6, R-DAY33, ADR-008): code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/auth/NimbusTokenIssuer.java, goi qua AuthService.tokenIssuer.issue(user); proving test src/test/java/com/spendwise/auth/NimbusTokenIssuerTest.java (issuesAVerifiableHs256JwtCarryingSubjectAndRoles va aSubThirtyTwoByteSecretFailsAtEncodeNotAtConstruction chung minh secret < 32 byte fail luc encode chu khong luc construct).

Hang 'no 202' (per-row atomicity + phan hoi dong bo): code path src/main/java/com/spendwise/imports/ImportController.java tra ResponseEntity.created(...) tuc 201 dong bo chu khong 202 Accepted; va src/main/java/com/spendwise/imports/ImportRowProcessor.java co chu thich giai thich vi sao KHONG @Transactional (moi row co transaction rieng qua create(), row 42 hong khong roll back row 1-41); proving test src/test/java/com/spendwise/imports/ImportRowProcessorTest.java.

Hang AI advisory boundary (ADR-016): kiem tra thuc te bang grep tren src/main - khong co lop AI/advisory nao ton tai. Ghi day la mot muc 'KHONG xay - ngoai pham vi V1.0', voi ly do pham vi ro rang, KHONG che ma gia de co ve co tra loi. Buoc 2 se mo rong cac muc not-built kieu nay.

Kiem chung tung hang truoc khi chot: moi code path phai la file co that (mo len xem), moi proving test phai la method/DisplayName co that trong suite, moi rule id phai trung dung chuoi @DisplayName. Neu mot vung co code nhung thieu test, buoc 2 se them test; neu thieu ca code thi ghi not-built.

commonErrors.symptom: Mot hang trong bang ghi rule id la 'R2' nhung khong khop chuoi @DisplayName that, hoac trich mot ten test khong ton tai trong suite.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Viet bo ba tu tri nho thay vi mo file test va migration ra kiem chung - dung cai kiem toan nay co gang chong lai.
commonErrors.fix: Voi moi hang, mo file test va copy dung ten method (vi du treatsEquivalentScalesAsEqualMoney) va dung chuoi @DisplayName ('R24: SecurityContextHolder is read in exactly one class...'). Bo ba nao khong kiem chung duoc thi phai xu ly o buoc 2, khong duoc de nguyen.

guidedSteps.title: Dong mot lo hong kiem toan bang regression test that; ghi cac muc 'khong xay' trung thuc
guidedSteps.goal: Kiem toan phai 'can': chon mot cau hoi ma bang buoc 1 cho thay co code nhung thieu proving test, viet DefenseAuditRegressionTest.java lam no pass; dong thoi ghi vao docs/defense-audit.md cac muc 'khong xay - ngoai pham vi' cho bank sync va universal dedup kem ly do pham vi - khong doi hanh vi production ngoai viec them test.
guidedSteps.whyThisMatters: Mot kiem toan khong bao gio can la kiem toan trang tri. Muc tieu la chung minh no bat duoc mot diem yeu that va bien no thanh mot regression test dang pass, nen cau hoi do o buoi bao ve co the tra bang mot test chay truoc mat giam khao. R26 (schema discipline / khong retrofit ma de tra loi de hon) buoc phai trung thuc: cau hoi 'co dong bo ngan hang khong', 'co chong trung universal khong' phai duoc ghi la KHONG xay voi ly do pham vi, khong duoc voi va che mot capability moi chi de bang trong dep. V1.0 la ban cuoi - dieu can la phong thu duoc cai da co, khong phai them kien truc.

theoryBridge.note: Testing Spring Boot: chon dung tier test cho lo hong duoc dong - neu la bat bien thuan Java thi unit test, neu can boot Flyway/DB thi slice/integration; DefenseAuditRegressionTest mo rong dung mot suite phu hop chu khong dung khung moi.

Final Defense: muc 'khong xay - ngoai pham vi' cho bank sync/universal dedup la cau tra loi trung thuc cho cau hoi ngoai pham vi, gia tri o buoi bao ve khong kem gi mot dong code - no cho thay ban biet ranh gioi he thong.

run.explanation: Chay verify command canonical cua buildStep trong learner workspace de xac nhan buoc da xong dung.

learnerAction.goal: Chon mot vung ma bang buoc 1 lo ra co code path nhung proving test con yeu hoac thieu (vi du mot canh cua per-row atomicity, cua source_ref conflict, hoac cua ranh gioi 404-not-403 chua co test truc tiep), viet src/test/java/com/spendwise/shared/DefenseAuditRegressionTest.java trong package com.spendwise.shared de dong dung lo hong do va lam no pass; dong thoi cap nhat docs/defense-audit.md: hang do tro toi test moi, va them cac muc 'khong xay - ngoai pham vi' cho bank sync va universal dedup kem ly do pham vi.
constraints: It nhat mot lo hong ma buoc 1 phat hien phai duoc dong bang mot regression test that su chay pass - test phai fail neu hanh vi bi lam hong, khong phai mot test luon-xanh vo nghia.

Khong doi hanh vi production nao ngoai viec them test: chi tao/mo rong file test, khong sua lop trong src/main de 'tra loi de hon' (R26 - khong retrofit, khong them capability/dependency/rule moi; blueprint V1.0: none new).
Cac cau hoi ngoai pham vi hop le (bank sync, universal bank dedup) phai duoc ghi la muc 'khong xay' kem ly do pham vi cu the trong docs/defense-audit.md - khong duoc che ma gia de bang co ve day du.

DefenseAuditRegressionTest dat trong com.spendwise.shared va chon dung tier: neu lo hong la bat bien thuan Java thi test khong can Spring context; neu can schema/DB that thi ke thua ha tang integration/slice da co (vi du IntegrationTestBase) thay vi dung moi.
Sau khi them test, chay ca suite mot lan de xac nhan khong pha vo bat cu test V0.1-V0.9 nao dang xanh.
hints: Cach tim lo hong nhanh: quet lai bang buoc 1, tim hang nao cot 'proving test' de trong hoac chi mo ta bang loi chu chung chung - do la ung vien so mot. Vi du neu ranh gioi 404-not-403 chi duoc phu boi mot @DisplayName kien truc chu chua co test HTTP truc tiep cho dung endpoint ban se noi o buoi bao ve, do la mot lo hong dang dong.

Muc 'khong xay' viet duoc ba dong: (1) cau hoi la gi, (2) tai sao ngoai pham vi V1.0 (vi du: import doc file CSV nguoi dung tu tai len, khong ket noi API ngan hang; identity la per-import fingerprint+OCC theo ADR-007, khong phai universal cross-bank dedup), (3) neu can lam trong tuong lai thi cham vao dau.

Neu lo hong ban chon la per-row atomicity, ImportRowProcessorTest da co san - hay dam bao co dung mot test khang dinh 'row hong o giua khong roll back cac row truoc no', neu chua co thi do chinh la regression test ban them vao DefenseAuditRegressionTest.

commonErrors.symptom: De 'dong lo hong' bang cach sua mot lop trong src/main hoac them mot co che moi (vi du them endpoint hay flag) roi moi viet test cho no.
commonErrors.likelyCause: Hieu nham 'dong lo hong' la 'them tinh nang' - trong khi V1.0 la ban cuoi va acceptance criteria cam doi hanh vi production ngoai viec them test.
commonErrors.fix: R26: khong retrofit. Neu mot cau hoi that su thieu code thi no la muc 'khong xay - ngoai pham vi', khong phai co de viet code moi. Chi lo hong nao la 'code da co nhung chua co test chung minh' moi duoc dong, va dong bang test - khong sua src/main.

guidedSteps.title: Checkpoint: Defense-readiness audit against the question matrix da xong dung yeu cau
guidedSteps.goal: Xac nhan moi buildStep cua task-defense-audit deu pass verify va tuan dung cac rule kien truc cua no.

understanding: Vì sao đường dẫn thư mục phải khớp tên package trong Java.
pom.xml khai báo Java version và dependency nào cho project, và Maven Wrapper giải quyết vấn đề gì (ai chạy project cũng cùng một phiên bản Maven).
mvnw.cmd test tự tìm và chạy mọi *Test.java dưới src/test/java mà không cần chỉ định file.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Một project Maven Java 17 thuần, không Spring, chạy được (mvnw exec:java) và test được (mvnw test), đã có commit đầu tiên sạch làm baseline.
whyNotYet: Chưa có class nghiệp vụ nào (Money, Account, Transaction) — project hiện tại chỉ chứng minh toolchain chạy được.
Chưa dùng Spring: object duy nhất trong project (SpendwiseApp) được JVM gọi trực tiếp qua main(), chưa có container nào quản lý vòng đời object.

understanding: Vì sao double/float không phù hợp để đại diện tiền, và BigDecimal giải quyết vấn đề đó thế nào.
Sự khác biệt giữa BigDecimal.equals() (so cả scale) và BigDecimal.compareTo() (chỉ so giá trị) — và vì sao Money.equals() phải dùng compareTo.
Vì sao Money bất biến (immutable): add/subtract luôn trả về object mới, không sửa object cũ.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Kiểu Money bất biến, chuẩn hoá scale 2 HALF_UP khi khởi tạo, so sánh đúng theo giá trị tiền tệ, chặn cộng trừ khác đơn vị tiền.
whyNotYet: Money hiện ném IllegalArgumentException (ngoại lệ chuẩn của Java) thay vì một exception miền nghiệp vụ riêng — task Domain Validation (session cuối) sẽ giới thiệu InvalidAmountException/CurrencyMismatchException và thay thế các lời gọi này.
Chưa có Account hay Transaction nào dùng Money — Money vẫn đang là một kiểu độc lập, chưa gắn vào bất kỳ luồng nghiệp vụ nào.

understanding: Vì sao Account không có setBalance — mọi thay đổi số dư đi qua phương thức nghiệp vụ có kiểm tra.
Quy ước dấu hiệu: INCOME/TRANSFER_IN cộng, EXPENSE/TRANSFER_OUT trừ, và vì sao chính bản thân hiệu ứng (amount truyền vào) luôn phải dương.
Vì sao constructor kiểm tra cả ba tham số (name, type, openingBalance) trước khi gán bất kỳ field nào.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Account với số dư khởi tạo hợp lệ, đổi qua 4 phương thức nghiệp vụ tuân theo quy ước dấu hiệu, không có cách nào gán balance trực tiếp từ bên ngoài.
whyNotYet: TRANSFER_IN/TRANSFER_OUT tồn tại trên Account nhưng TransactionType (session sau) chưa có hai giá trị này — Account 'sẵn sàng trước' cho tính năng chuyển khoản chưa thuộc phạm vi V0.1.
Vẫn ném IllegalArgumentException chung chung — session Domain Validation cuối cùng sẽ thay bằng exception miền nghiệp vụ.

understanding: Vì sao Transaction.amount luôn dương và chiều (thu/chi) nằm trong TransactionType, không nằm trong dấu của amount.
Domain Transaction (một giao dịch tài chính) khác hoàn toàn với @Transactional của Spring (ranh giới database) dù trùng tên tiếng Anh.
signedEffect() trên enum là nguồn chân lý duy nhất cho chiều tác động của mỗi loại giao dịch lên số dư.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Transaction ghi lại một sự kiện tài chính hợp lệ: amount dương, hướng rõ ràng qua TransactionType, gắn với một Account cụ thể.
whyNotYet: Chưa dùng Spring @Transactional — khái niệm đó thuộc tầng kỹ thuật quản lý ranh giới database, sẽ gặp ở giai đoạn Spring Data sau này, và không liên quan tới domain Transaction bạn vừa xây.
Transaction chưa gắn Category — session tiếp theo sẽ thêm khả năng phân loại.

understanding: Vì sao một tập giá trị cố định, biết trước, nên là enum thay vì String tự do.
Category ở V0.1 vẫn là một kiểu Java thuần trong bộ nhớ — chưa có ID, chưa lưu database, persistence là chuyện của giai đoạn sau.
Transaction có hai constructor: một không bắt buộc category, một bắt buộc — và constructor sau tái sử dụng validate của constructor trước qua this(...).
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Category enum với 5 giá trị MVP, và Transaction có thể mang theo một category bắt buộc khi được gán.
whyNotYet: Category chưa có ID hay khả năng người dùng tự thêm category mới — đó là tính năng của giai đoạn có persistence, chưa thuộc V0.1.

understanding: Vì sao nhóm exception theo tên (DomainException gốc, các loại con cụ thể) giúp caller bắt đúng loại lỗi mình quan tâm.
DomainException extends RuntimeException (unchecked) — vi phạm bất biến domain là lỗi lập trình, caller không bị compiler ép phải try/catch.
Validate không chỉ là 'từ chối cái sai' — luồng hợp lệ đầy đủ nhất cũng cần một test chứng minh nó không bao giờ bị từ chối nhầm.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Toàn bộ Money/Account/Transaction giờ ném đúng loại exception miền nghiệp vụ (InvalidAmountException, CurrencyMismatchException, DomainException) thay vì IllegalArgumentException chung chung, và một test pin lại luồng nghiệp vụ hợp lệ hoàn chỉnh.
guidedCheckpoints.expectedProjectTree:
D:\spendwise-learning\
  pom.xml, mvnw.cmd, .mvn\..., .gitignore
  src\main\java\com\spendwise\
    SpendwiseApp.java
    shared\Money.java, DomainException.java, InvalidAmountException.java, CurrencyMismatchException.java
    account\Account.java, AccountType.java, Transaction.java, TransactionType.java
    category\Category.java
  src\test\java\com\spendwise\ (một *Test.java cho mỗi class main tương ứng)
whyNotYet: V0.1 kết thúc ở đây: object graph (Account, Transaction, Category) vẫn được bạn tự tay new lên bằng Java code thuần — chưa có ApplicationContext, chưa có @Component/@Service nào quản lý vòng đời chúng. V0.3 mới bắt đầu để Spring IoC Container đảm nhận việc đó.
Chưa có database — mọi object chỉ sống trong bộ nhớ JVM, mất hết khi chương trình dừng. Persistence (JPA/PostgreSQL) thuộc các giai đoạn sau, xây trên đúng domain model bạn vừa hoàn thành.
Chưa có REST API, chưa có CSV import/export — đây là các buildTask của các release sau, chưa mở khoá ở V0.1.

understanding: Vì sao domain/service code nên phụ thuộc vào một interface (Repository<T, ID>) thay vì một cách lưu trữ cụ thể.
Cách generics <T, ID> cho phép một interface phục vụ nhiều kiểu entity mà vẫn giữ type safety.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Một interface Repository<T, ID> generic với save/find/findAll/delete, chứng minh dùng được cho cả Account lẫn Transaction.
whyNotYet: Chưa có cài đặt thật nào — interface không lưu được gì cho tới khi InMemoryRepository xuất hiện ở session sau.

understanding: Vì sao InMemoryRepository cần một idExtractor thay vì tự biết field ID của từng entity.
Vì sao test khai báo biến kiểu Repository<T, ID> thay vì InMemoryRepository chứng minh được điều gì đó quan trọng.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Một cài đặt Repository<T, ID> dựa trên Map, lưu-tìm-xoá đúng và test được hoàn toàn qua interface.
whyNotYet: Dữ liệu vẫn chỉ sống trong bộ nhớ — tắt app là mất; CSV (session cuối V0.2) mới cho dữ liệu sống sót qua một lần chạy, và database thật còn ở V0.5+.

understanding: Vì sao R20 yêu cầu một cửa duy nhất (TransactionCreationService.create) cho mọi giao dịch tạo trong code sản phẩm.
Vì sao sourceRef phải được gán ngay từ giao dịch thủ công đầu tiên, không đợi đến khi có import/recurring.
Vì sao tầng đọc (TransactionService) và tầng tạo (TransactionCreationService) là hai class tách biệt.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Một cửa tạo giao dịch duy nhất gán sourceRef cho mọi bản ghi, và một tầng đọc/lọc độc lập chỉ phụ thuộc Repository interface.
whyNotYet: sourceRef mới chỉ có tiền tố MANUAL: — IMPORT:/RECURRING: sẽ xuất hiện khi các tính năng đó được xây ở các release sau.
Chưa có thống kê nào trên dữ liệu này — session kế tiếp mới cộng và gom nhóm số liệu.

understanding: Vì sao Collectors.summingDouble không tương thích với BigDecimal, và .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add) là lựa chọn thay thế đúng (R1).
Vì sao một bất biến kiểm chứng bằng máy (grep-able) đáng tin hơn một quy ước chỉ ghi trong tài liệu.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: Thống kê gom nhóm theo category và tổng thu/chi, hoàn toàn BigDecimal, không một double/float nào trong package statistics.
whyNotYet: Số liệu vẫn tính trên dữ liệu in-memory — chưa lưu xuống file, tắt app là số liệu mất theo (session cuối V0.2 giải quyết phần lưu trữ).

understanding: Vì sao amount.toPlainString() (không phải toString()) là bắt buộc khi ghi BigDecimal ra CSV.
Vì sao try-with-resources trên Files.lines() (một Stream<String>) không phải tuỳ chọn — nó là AutoCloseable.
Vì sao so sánh round-trip phải dùng compareTo, không dùng equals hay so sánh chuỗi.
guidedCheckpoints.whatYouBuilt: V0.2 hoàn tất: Repository interface, cài đặt in-memory, tầng service với một cửa tạo giao dịch duy nhất, thống kê BigDecimal-pure, và lưu/đọc CSV không mất một cent nào qua vòng round-trip.
whyNotYet: Chưa có Spring Boot, chưa có REST API, chưa có database thật — app vẫn chạy hoàn toàn trong bộ nhớ JVM của một lần thực thi, chỉ có file CSV là sống sót qua lần chạy tiếp theo. V0.3 mới đưa Spring context vào.
